# Intelligence Arbitrage (Metrum AI)

Frozen snapshot `2026-11-07T22:24:47Z` of the Metrum AI Coding Intelligence Arbitrage tracker.
Metric: cheapest blended $/1M tokens (3:1 input:output) divided by Artificial Analysis coding score. Lower is better.
Do not fetch the live tracker; this snapshot is the source of truth until it is rebuilt.

## Routing rules

1. Default coding model: the top of **Workhorse** (score ≥ 40). Right now `openai/gpt-6.1-terra` (GPT-6.1 Terra, 47.6 pts, $0.0420/pt).
2. Mechanical subtasks (grep-and-summarise, renames, test scaffolds, commit messages, log triage): **Subtask** tier, starting with `anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5` (Claude Haiku 5.5).
3. Use **Frontier** after a workhorse attempt fails, or directly for architecture, concurrency or security work. Top pick: `anthropic/claude-opus-5-5` (Claude Opus 5.5, 51.7).
4. Never pick a model below 30 for code that ships, however cheap.
5. When two picks sit within 10% on $/pt, prefer the higher score.
6. Prices move. Treat anything older than 30 days as stale and say so when recommending.
7. OpenRouter ids retain `:nitro` to request the routing mode used by this snapshot. Nitro selects by throughput; it does not pin the named backend or guarantee the snapshot price. Configure missing ids in pi before selecting them (see README.md).
8. Choose only available, configured models. If a preferred model is unavailable, try the next in the same tier; report if none are available.
